title: Free video-streaming service Tubi lets users share curated watchlists now
gist: Fox-owned free ad-supported streamer Tubi launched 'Mixtapes', user-curated shareable watchlists drawn from its ~400,000 titles, aimed at the content-discovery problem that Gracenote data shows drives cancellations and abandoned sessions. Better discovery supports Tubi's ad business, and human curation may keep costs lower than AI recommendation.

insights.claim: Fox-owned free ad-supported streaming service Tubi launched 'Mixtapes', letting users build, order, and publicly share watchlists from its nearly 400,000 movies and TV episodes, optionally starting from a Tubi-generated draft based on a description.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Social curation is a low-cost engagement feature for FAST services.

insights.claim: Watching a Tubi Mixtape requires no account but creating one does, turning shared lists into a sign-up funnel.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Shareable lists can drive account growth and reach for an ad-supported service.

insights.claim: Gracenote's 2025 State of Play survey of 3,000 consumers in six countries found nearly 33% of streaming users say fragmentation hurts their TV experience, 49% would cancel a service over difficulty finding what to watch, and 19% abandon a session after an unsuccessful search.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Discovery friction is a quantified churn driver across streaming.
insights.locator: Tubi’s Mixtapes comes at a time

insights.claim: Easier content discovery can help Tubi grow its user base and viewing time, which directly supports the advertising business it relies on.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Engagement gains flow to Fox's ad revenue from Tubi.
insights.locator: Although Tubi users don’t have paid subscriptions

insights.claim: Shareable watchlists are rare among streaming services; Mubi offers followable lists, and Plex and JustWatch also let users share curated watchlists.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Feature is a modest differentiator rather than a moat.

insights.claim: Human-curated recommendations may appeal to some viewers more than AI recommendation systems while keeping Tubi's costs lower, as rivals raise subscription prices.
insights.speaker: Scharon Harding
insights.so_what: Free, human-curated discovery is a counter-positioning against pricier subscription streamers.
insights.locator: Still, it’s nice to see a streaming service
